problem.passage:
Marine biologists have long puzzled over why the deep-sea anglerfish species Melanocetus johnsonii exhibits such extreme sexual dimorphism, with females growing up to sixty times the length of males. Recent tagging studies reveal that free-swimming male anglerfish possess unusually large olfactory organs and eyes adapted to detect faint bioluminescent signals, suggesting that males invest most of their limited energy reserves in locating a mate rather than in growing large or hunting independently. Once a male finds a female in the vast, food-scarce darkness of the deep ocean, he bites into her flesh and gradually fuses with her circulatory system, becoming a permanent parasitic appendage that provides sperm on demand. Researchers note that this reproductive strategy would be especially advantageous in an environment where encounters between individuals of the same species are exceedingly rare. If a male anglerfish were to release the female after mating, as many surface-dwelling fish species do, he would likely ______

Which choice most logically completes the text?
problem.stimulus: Marine biologists have long puzzled over why the deep-sea anglerfish species Melanocetus johnsonii exhibits such extreme sexual dimorphism, with females growing up to sixty times the length of males. Recent tagging studies reveal that free-swimming male anglerfish possess unusually large olfactory organs and eyes adapted to detect faint bioluminescent signals, suggesting that males invest most of their limited energy reserves in locating a mate rather than in growing large or hunting independently. Once a male finds a female in the vast, food-scarce darkness of the deep ocean, he bites into her flesh and gradually fuses with her circulatory system, becoming a permanent parasitic appendage that provides sperm on demand. Researchers note that this reproductive strategy would be especially advantageous in an environment where encounters between individuals of the same species are exceedingly rare. If a male anglerfish were to release the female after mating, as many surface-dwelling fish species do, he would likely ______
problem.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?
options: face a very low probability of locating another suitable mate before his energy reserves were depleted
develop the same bioluminescent lure that females use to attract prey in the surrounding water
be forced to compete with other males for access to the limited food supply near the seafloor
gain the ability to grow to a size comparable to that of the female anglerfish he had just left
problem.explanation: 지문에 따르면 심해에서는 같은 종 개체끼리 마주칠 확률이 극히 낮기 때문에 수컷이 암컷과 영구적으로 결합하는 전략이 유리하다고 설명한다. 만약 수컷이 짝짓기 후 암컷을 놓아준다면, 에너지가 고갈되기 전에 또 다른 암컷을 찾을 확률이 매우 낮을 것이라는 결론이 지문의 핵심 논리와 직접 연결된다. 따라서 정답은 A번이다. B번은 지문에 없는 내용으로 수컷이 발광 기관을 발달시킨다는 근거가 전혀 없다. C번은 먹이 경쟁이라는 지문에 언급되지 않은 요소를 끌어들인 것이다. D번은 지문의 핵심과 정반대로, 수컷이 암컷 크기로 자란다는 것은 극단적 성적 이형성을 설명하는 지문의 전제와 모순된다.
problem.explanationEn: According to the passage, encounters between individuals of the same species are exceedingly rare in the deep sea, which makes permanent fusion advantageous for the male. If the male released the female after mating, he would face a very low probability of finding another mate before his limited energy reserves ran out—this follows directly from the passage's stated logic. Therefore, the correct answer is A. B introduces a claim not supported by the passage; there is no indication males develop bioluminescent lures. C introduces food competition, a detail not discussed in the passage. D directly contradicts the passage's premise of extreme sexual dimorphism, since males are described as far smaller than females, not eventually equal in size.
problem.evidenceTarget: The passage implies that permanent fusion is adaptive because separate encounters between mates are rare in the deep sea, so releasing the female would likely doom the male's reproductive chances.
problem.evidenceSpan: this reproductive strategy would be especially advantageous in an environment where encounters between individuals of the same species are exceedingly rare
problem.answerRationale: 지문은 개체 간 조우가 극히 드문 환경에서 영구 결합이 유리하다고 설명하므로, 결합을 풀면 다시 짝을 찾기 어려워 번식 기회를 잃을 것이라는 추론이 논리적으로 이어진다.

difficultyReasons: 빈칸 채우기 추론은 지문 전체의 논지(짝짓기 기회의 희소성과 기생적 결합의 진화적 이점)를 종합해야 함(2단계 추론)
정답이 지문에 직접 언급되지 않고 '만약 놓아준다면'이라는 가정법적 결과를 논리적으로 추론해야 함
오답 C는 먹이 부족이라는 실제 언급된 정보를 활용해 그럴듯하게 보이므로 변별이 필요함
오답 B, D는 지문과 명백히 무관하거나 반대되는 내용이라 상대적으로 쉽게 제거 가능

distractors.plausibleBecause: 암컷이 생물발광 유인체를 가지고 있다는 정보가 지문에 나오므로, 수컷이 그것을 발달시킨다는 생각이 얼핏 관련 있어 보일 수 있음
distractors.matches: female possess bioluminescent signals that males detect
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 수컷이 발광 신호를 '감지'하는 눈을 가졌다고 했지 스스로 발광 기관을 발달시킨다는 근거가 전혀 없으며, 이는 풀려난 후의 결과와 논리적으로 무관함

distractors.plausibleBecause: 심해는 먹이가 부족한 환경이라는 설명이 있어 먹이 경쟁이라는 개념이 그럴듯해 보일 수 있음
distractors.matches: food-scarce darkness of the deep ocean
distractors.whyWrong: 지문의 핵심 논지는 짝을 찾는 것이 극히 어렵다는 것이지 먹이를 둘러싼 경쟁이 아니며, 수컷이 독립적으로 사냥하지 않는다는 내용과도 모순됨

distractors.plausibleBecause: 수컷이 기생하여 암컷과 결합하면 영양분을 공급받아 자랄 수 있다는 오해에서 비롯될 수 있음
distractors.whyWrong: 지문은 극단적인 성적 이형성(암컷이 수컷의 60배)이 자연스러운 상태임을 강조하며, 떨어져 나온다고 갑자기 암컷 크기로 자랄 수 있다는 근거가 전혀 없음. 오히려 반대의 함의(수컷은 원래 작다)를 가짐
